tools.name: search_villas
tools.description: Find Dhananjaya villas and resorts in Bali that are available for the dates, with the lowest price for the stay and a booking link. Optionally filter by area (e.g. Ubud, Canggu, East Bali), maximum price per night, or breakfast included.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Every available room type and rate plan of one villa for the dates, with the price for the stay and a booking link.

tools.name: villa_details
tools.description: Description, location, facilities, house rules, Google rating, room types and photos of one villa.

tools.name: current_offers
tools.description: The promotions running on book.dhananjaya.id (e.g. Best Rate Guarantee, Early Bird, Stay Longer) and their conditions.
